games.name: Diggin
games.description: Drill into a meteor crater, mine ores and unlock upgrades while uncovering what happened to the moles that came before you.

games.name: Dwarf Eats Mountain
games.description: A whimsical game about gold-hungry dwarves chewing through ever-bigger mountains, digging up riches and artifacts along the way.

games.name: Fracture Field
games.description: Shatter quarry rocks with timed swings, then automate the work with fleets of drones, bombs and prestige upgrades.

games.name: Mining Wizards
games.description: Mine minerals as a wizard, grow a huge skill tree, unlock talents and collect artifacts that attract special visitors.

games.name: Rock Crusher
games.description: A minimalist game about a small rock-crushing machine stranded on a strange planet, with a massive skill tree between you and escape.

games.name: Shelldiver
games.description: A cozy game about a senior turtle starting a business selling jellyfish, upgrading diving gear and exploring underwater biomes.

games.name: Space Rock Breaker
games.description: Mine asteroids with guns, process the ore by dropping it into a Plinko machine, and work through a massive skill tree.

games.name: You Know The Drill
games.description: A relaxing, retro-styled game about drilling ever deeper underground and harvesting ores to upgrade your drill.

games.name: Chop Chains
games.description: A relaxing pixel-art game about chopping trees and upgrading axes and skills to become the ultimate lumberjack.

games.name: It's Chopping Time!
games.description: Clear an island's forests with the forces of nature, from earthquakes and tornadoes to tidal waves, seen from an isometric view.

games.name: Fishing Inc
games.description: A cozy, colorful fishing game: catch fish, unlock skills, master new ponds and fill your fish log with legendary catches.

games.name: Auto Snakes in Outer Space
games.description: A slow, meditative idler where colorful snakes gather food that you spend on upgrades and abilities for their colony.

games.name: Gamblers Table
games.description: A minimalist, cute game about flipping coins for money, buying better coins and hiring little helpers to flip them for you.

games.name: Scritchy Scratchy
games.description: Buy stacks of scratch cards, unlock auto-scratching and chase huge jackpots, deciding when to play it safe and when to go all in.

games.name: Slot Grind
games.description: Spin slot machines, reinvest your winnings into better machines and automation, and work your way out of debt.

games.name: Slots & Diapers
games.description: An absurd pixel-art game about spinning for jackpots and hiring veteran gamblers to automate the madness.

games.name: Bills Must Be Paid
games.description: A short, active game about smashing piggy banks to pay your bills and finally get out of debt.

games.name: Idle Gumball Machine
games.description: A Plinko-style game: shoot gumballs at gears and stack upgrades until the numbers get big enough to break the game.

games.name: Pegfinity
games.description: A colorful pixel-art pachinko game about launching balls into pegs and chaining upgrades into ridiculous scores.

games.name: Get Rid Of Those Corners
games.description: A minimalist, geometric game about clearing the sides of shapes to trigger physical chain reactions, with over 130 upgrades.

games.name: Click and Conquer
games.description: A short, relaxing pixel-art game about dropping bombs through the fog of war to uncover hidden enemies and new maps.

games.name: Astro Prospector
games.description: An incremental bullet hell about mining coffee in space, fighting a mega-corporation and upgrading your ship.

games.name: Minutescape
games.description: A retro-inspired bullet hell where you dodge, upgrade and keep unlocking abilities until you can survive five straight minutes.

games.name: Void Miner
games.description: A retro-inspired asteroid shooter: pilot a ship alongside an automated tower and blast your way through endless asteroid fields.

games.name: Rocket Rats
games.description: A pixel-art survivors-like where you fight cheese-based astral bodies in space, as a rat.

games.name: IGNOBLE
games.description: A gory 2D beat 'em up where you feed your father the blood and bones of your enemies to grow stronger.

games.name: IncreKnight
games.description: A pixel-art adventure about growing strong enough to slay a dragon.

games.name: Increbraintal
games.description: An auto battler about protecting a brain from viruses, with a skill tree at its core.

games.name: Loot Loop
games.description: Build a party of heroes and send them on quick dungeon runs for loot, upgrades and a deep skill tree.

games.name: Maktala: Slime Lootfest
games.description: Fight hordes of slimes and use their loot to grow stronger, with plenty of skills and gear to master.

games.name: Outhold
games.description: A short, minimalist mix of tower defense and deep meta-progression, built around finding overpowered synergies.

games.name: Sir, We Have an Orc Problem
games.description: A tower defense game where overwhelming hordes of orcs meet even more bullets, bombs and lasers.

games.name: Zero Stress King: Idle Defense
games.description: A short, relaxing pixel-art game dressed up as tower defense, except the enemies can never reach your walls.

games.name: Slimeward
games.description: Build and upgrade a side-scrolling village and recruit heroes to fight off the slimes at your door.

games.name: Horripilant
games.description: An idle dungeon crawl through a dark, forgotten underworld, told in pixel art.

games.name: Chef Knight
games.description: A cozy, hand-drawn fantasy game about hunting monsters in dungeons, cooking them and serving the dishes to hungry adventurers.

games.name: Holding Pattern
games.description: A minimalist game about defending your galaxy with moons and abilities, with both incremental and roguelike modes.

games.name: A Game About Feeding A Black Hole
games.description: Feed a black hole by destroying asteroids, planets and stars.

games.name: A Game About Making A Planet
games.description: A short, slow-paced game about merging particles until they become a planet. It takes about one to two hours.

games.name: Starvester
games.description: Expand a factory across a star system with swarms of drones and build giant megastructures.

games.name: Sporbs
games.description: Pop alien organisms like space bubble wrap, then automate a factory and expand into new areas.

games.name: Tower Wizard
games.description: A colorful pixel-art game about helping a wizard build a tower to study magic, summon spirits and shape the world.

games.name: (the) Gnorp Apologue
games.description: Guide the cute little gnorps toward their goal of delightfully excessive wealth.

games.name: Cult Nation
games.description: A short game about sacrificing your cult's followers and collecting their blood to awaken the devil.

games.name: Fill Up The Hole
games.description: Build a city in a dystopian world, automate garbage production and throw it all into a magical hole for profit.

games.name: Garbage Growth
games.description: A short, darkly silly game about collecting trash, hiring rats and polluting the world for profit.

games.name: Simultree
games.description: Run life simulations as a scientist and spend the points they earn in a big skill tree.

games.name: IDLE_DIRECTIVE
games.description: A grid-based inventory and resource game about scavenging ruins and meeting survivors in a decaying world.

games.name: The Board is Yours
games.description: A demanding, chess-based idle game about buying squares, placing pieces and chaining synergies.

games.name: All Hail the Orb
games.description: A light-hearted pixel-art game about powering a mysterious orb, summoning cultists and slowly unlocking automation.
